mandatory_legal_checks: E-Commerce Rules 2020 R.4(4) and R.4(5) — grievance officer; acknowledge within 48 hours, redress within one month
E-Commerce Rules 2020 R.4 — no cancellation charge on the consumer unless the entity bears a similar charge
E-Commerce Rules 2020 R.4 — refunds to be effected within a reasonable period or as prescribed
Sale of Goods Act 1930 S.16 — implied conditions as to quality and fitness cannot be excluded against a consumer
Consumer Protection Act 2019 S.2(46) — an unfair contract term is void; a policy cannot exclude statutory rights
